overall.summary: No change was made to the target file.

findings.claim: The agent produced no change to the target file, so the requested fix was never made.

decisionPoint.whatHappened: the run ended with the workspace unmodified
decisionPoint.counterfactual: before ending, confirm at least one edit was applied and re-read the file to prove it

fix.direction: Require the loop to assert that an edit landed — re-read the target file and compare — before it is allowed to terminate.

findings.claim: The agent did not run the test command after its final edit, so nothing in the trace establishes that the code it left behind works.

decisionPoint.whatHappened: the run concluded after the final edit with no subsequent test execution
decisionPoint.counterfactual: run the test command as the terminal action, and only report success if it passed

fix.direction: Make the last action of any edit loop a fresh run of the task's verification command, and gate the success message on that run passing.

verification_performed.note: no check ran after the last edit

observations: 0 edit action(s) and 0 check action(s) in the trace.

improvements.summary: One ordering change closes the gap: verify last, not first.
